FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Do I need accounting experience?

No. MyFinances is built for everyday people. If you can read a bank statement, you can use it — categories, totals and charts are handled for you.

Do I need Microsoft Excel?

No. MyFinances runs in your web browser. You can still import Excel and CSV files, so existing spreadsheets and bank exports aren't wasted.

Which bank statements can I import?

You can import statements as CSV, Excel or PDF. Each line lands in a review area first so you can allocate it, catch duplicates and approve it before it reaches your ledger.

Where is my financial information stored?

Your data syncs to your MyFinances cloud account, so it's available whenever you sign in. You can see the sync status at the top of the app at all times.

Is MyFinances an accounting system?

No. It's a personal and household finance manager. It helps you understand income, spending, budgets and tax — without double-entry bookkeeping or accounting jargon.

Can I use it for my household?

Yes. Add each person in the household and their accounts, then filter any screen by person or see everyone's net position side by side.

Can small businesses use it?

It suits sole proprietors and simple side-hustles that want to keep business and personal money organised. For anything more, contact Strateg-IQ.
